claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows a horizontal seam dividing the side plates, which is the distinct design feature of the Slim model.
General photos cannot confirm the absence of internal dust, fine scratches, or odors.

risks.risk: Console may be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be faulty or unable to read discs.
risks.proof: A video showing a game disc being inserted, recognized, and ejected.
risks.if_unproven: as a Digital Edition console with a broken drive.

risks.risk: The HDMI port or internal APU may be damaged (no display).
risks.proof: A video of the console powering on and displaying the home screen on a TV.

risks.risk: The controller may have 'stick drift' or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used in a game or a controller tester app.
risks.if_unproven: as a faulty controller requiring replacement.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and loading a game disc.
Photo of the rear ports to check for HDMI damage.
Video showing the console connected to the internet and signed into PSN.
Close-up photo of the model and serial number sticker.
response.reason: The witness has confirmed the item is a PS5 Slim with a disc drive and controller. It can be priced based on its worst-case functional state.
